refundPolicy.introduction: This Refund Policy outlines how refunds are handled for event tickets and shop purchases across the Viet Vibe Foundation platform.

eventTickets.description: Event ticket refunds can range from 50% to 100%, depending on the refund policy defined by each event organizer.
eventTickets.item1: Each event may define its own refund rules, deadlines, and eligibility conditions.
eventTickets.item2: Tickets purchased within 1-2 weeks before the event start date may not be eligible for a refund.
eventTickets.item3: Please review the refund policy on each event page before purchasing your ticket.
eventTickets.item4: Student discounts and subscription discounts are not always included in event pricing unless the event organizer explicitly approves them.

shop.description: For shop purchases, Viet Vibe Foundation does not interfere with refund decisions for partner shops, except for the official main VVF shop.
shop.item1: Every shop is required to provide its own policy, including refund terms.
shop.item2: Customers should review the specific shop's policy before placing an order.
shop.item3: VVF will always support users with refund-related concerns regardless of the cause, while still respecting each shop's published policy.

contact.description: For refund support or questions, our team is here to help.
